dedupe_keys.name: aged transformer spacer pressboard compression and polymerisation tests

description: This deposit contains degree-of-polymerisation measurements and compressive force–displacement curves for new and aged high-density pressboard used in transformer winding spacers. University of Cantabria laboratories tested oil-impregnated material supplied by Imefy after accelerated ageing at 150 degrees Celsius in the presence of copper. The article describes loading and unloading cycles on stacked specimens. Mendeley version 3 provides ZIP and RAR containers free under CC BY 4.0; the file formats within those containers were not inspected. Coverage is laboratory specimens in Santander, not transformer-fleet observations or a dated service-life record. Known limitations include accelerated ageing and sample geometry, which prevent direct translation to in-service failure probabilities. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating mechanical degradation components or checking insulation material assumptions in transformer reliability simulations. data-uk-power-station-transformer-dga-2010-2015 supplies complementary operational condition evidence, without a verified specimen-level link. No archive was fetched or force–displacement curve analysed.
